name: Transcriptions of Time
source:
When you and your friend Matt invent your new device in your Greenwich Village apartment in New York City, you begin your adventures together on time jumps across 3 unique centuries. Meet historical characters in 1926, your future tenants in 2126, and navigate the present in 2026 when your device begins a series of body transformations from a mysterious entity. 

A cozy slice of life story that focuses on a slow burn feminization journey. Will you embrace the transformations? Or risk losing yourself to unravel the mystery of the entity? 

The visual novel/game was built in twine/sugarcube and released with its vertical slice on August 15th 2026, the latest update on October 16. Still in development 

Itch : https://aliceintime.itch.io/transcriptions-of-time
Host site : https://transcriptionsoftime.com
translation:
当你和好友马特在纽约市格林威治村的公寓里发明出一台全新装置后，两人就此开启了横跨3个不同世纪的时空跳跃冒险：在1926年邂逅历史人物，在2126年结识未来的公寓租客，并在2026年的当下应对突如其来的异变——在某个神秘存在的干预下，这台装置正令你的身体发生一连串奇妙的转变。

这是一部温馨治愈的日常向故事，聚焦于一段循序渐进的女性化蜕变之旅。你是会坦然拥抱身体的变化，还是甘冒迷失自我的风险，去揭开那个神秘存在的真实面目？

本视觉小说/游戏基于Twine/SugarCube引擎开发，于2026年8月15日推出试玩切片版，最近一次更新于10月16日发布，目前仍在持续开发中。

itch.io：https://aliceintime.itch.io/transcriptions-of-time
主站：https://transcriptionsoftime.com
